summary.text: First page of WHO's 2017 routine immunization profile for Switzerland, showing progress on European Vaccine Action Plan goals, financing indicators and the national immunization schedule.

blocks.content: Map of Switzerland by canton, one of three maps on the page of reported vaccination coverage by subnational area in 2017 (DTP3, MCV2 and MCV1; legend on the page: ≥95%, 90–94%, 80–89%, <80%). Several cantons, including a large west-central area and a small northern canton, are dark blue, and two smaller eastern cantons are light blue. Most cantons are grey.

Map of Switzerland by canton, one of three maps on the page of reported vaccination coverage by subnational area in 2017 (DTP3, MCV2 and MCV1; legend on the page: ≥95%, 90–94%, 80–89%, <80%). Several cantons, including a large west-central area and a small northern canton, are dark blue; a western and a central canton are light blue; and one small eastern canton is orange. Most cantons are grey.

Map of Switzerland by canton, one of three maps on the page of reported vaccination coverage by subnational area in 2017 (DTP3, MCV2 and MCV1; legend on the page: ≥95%, 90–94%, 80–89%, <80%). The large west-central area and a central and an eastern canton are orange, while a small northern canton and a north-western area are light blue. Most cantons are grey.
